name: idle-rpg
description: Idle RPG — idle RPG с автобоем для Telegram Mini App

scripts.build: npm run build -w @idle/shared && npm run build -w @idle/client && npm run build -w @idle/server
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @idle/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @idle/shared && npm run typecheck -w @idle/client && npm run typecheck -w @idle/server
